svg.text: Bars show requests per second. The label is the throughput factor relative to the fastest server, marked by the dashed
line. Each range is the spread of the comparison — the round-paired ratios, converted back to requests per second — not
the spread of the server alone; a range that crosses the dashed line means the two could not be told apart in this run.
12 cores, 7910 MB · Linux 6.8.0-139-generic · c=32,64,96, 10s per cell, 5 repeats
Volucer 0.6.0 (132f560) · RoadRunner 3.0.1 · FrankenPHP v1.13.4 · nginx 1.24.0 · PHP 8.5.11
